prayerExcerpt.en-US: In his old age St. Omer became blind, but that affliction did not lessen his pastoral concern for his flock.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Em sua velhice, Santo Omer ficou cego, mas essa aflição não diminuiu o seu cuidado pastoral por seu rebanho.

meta.face: A Frank of about seventy with a pale, weathered complexion and a HEXAGONAL face of FLAT PLANES — a BROAD, FLAT forehead crossed by deep level lines, ANGULAR cheekbones set WIDE, a LONG, fleshy nose ending in a ROUNDED, BULBOUS tip, a LONG upper lip, a BROAD, FLAT chin; the EYES gently CLOSED under heavy lids, for he is blind, with thick, straight white brows; a short, CLOSE-TRIMMED white beard following the jaw; white hair showing below the mitre; the face serene and listening. Not the round, soft Eleutherius of this batch, nor the white-bearded nicholas with his full curled beard.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; later statues show a bearded bishop. The book and Santi e Beati both say he went blind in old age (by 663, still signing acts in 664 and 667), so the card paints him with closed eyes, as a distinguishing mark; the structure is ours.
